issue.title: Recipes - Create Recipe
issue.description:
## 💡 User Story
As a contributor,
I want to create an recipe,
so that other users can try making them.

## 📋Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] contributor and admin role users with the permission create:recipes can access the page
- [ ] visitor users without the create:recipes permission are redirected to homepage
- [ ] The create form includes: title, description, duration, difficulty, ingredients (dynamic list), steps (dynamic list), image(s)
- [ ] Ingredients can be added/removed dynamically without page reload
- [ ] Steps can be added/removed dynamically without page reload
- [ ] All required fields are filled in order to submit the recipe
- [ ] After submission the user is redirected to the newly created recipe page
- [ ] A nutritional details table is automatically created after the recipe submission
- [ ] After the submission of the recipe the nutritional details table is updated with info from OpenFoodFacts
- [ ] While nutritional data is being updated, a loading indicator is shown in the nutritional details table

## 🔍 Tech Analysis
### Backend
- POST /recipes
- Verify the requesting user has create:recipes permission
- Validate all required fields
- Create a recipe entry in the DB with all fields: title, description, duration, difficulty, ingredients, steps
- Images are uploaded to storage and the image path(s) are saved in the DB
- Create an empty nutritional details table entry linked to the recipe
- For each ingredient, check the DB for existing ingredient data
- If found, populate the nutritional details table from DB
- If not found, add the ingredient to a job queue for OpenFoodFacts data fetching
- As each result returns, add an entry for said ingredient to the DB and update the nutritional details table

### Frontend
- Page is conditionally accessible based on user.role === contributor or user.role === admin
- Users without create:recipes permission are redirected to the homepage
- Ingredients and steps are managed as dynamic lists in local state (add/remove without page reload)
- All required fields are validated before the form can be submitted
- On success, user is redirected to the newly created recipe page
- On error, show an error dialog notification
- While nutritional data is being fetched, show a loading indicator in the nutritional details table
